NBA Player Statistics and Draft Data

Source: R/data.R
nba_players.Rd

A dataset of NBA player statistics from the 1996-97 to to 2022-23 seasons, containing demographic information, draft information, and NBA season statistics. There is one row per player, per year they were active in the NBA. Undrafted players draft_number is listed as 'NA'.

Usage

nba_players

Format

## `nba_players` A data frame with 12,844 rows and 21 columns:

player_name

Player's name

team_abbreviation

Team that player was on at the end of the season

age

Age of player

player_height

Height of player (cm)

player_weight

Weight of player (kg)

college

Name of college player attended

country

Country player was born in

draft_year

Year player was drafted

draft_round

Draft round player was picked, NA if undrafted

draft_number

Overall number player was drafted, NA if undrafted

gp

Number of games played throughout the season

pts

Average number of points scored

reb

Average number of rebounds

ast

Average number of assists

net_rating

Team's point differential per 100 possessions while the player is on the court

oreb_pct

Percentage of available offensive rebounds the player grabbed while he was on the floor

dreb_pct

Percentage of available defensive rebounds the player grabbed while he was on the floor

usg_pct

Percentage of team plays used by the player while he was on the floor (FGA + Possession Ending FTA + TO) / POSS)

ts_pct

Measure of the player's shooting efficiency that takes into account free throws, 2 and 3 point shots (PTS / (2*(FGA + 0.44 * FTA)))

ast_pct

Percentage of teammate fgs player assisted while he was on the floor

season

NBA season

Source

<https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/justinas/nba-players-data>
